notes: Implementation-plan schema: backend generates timestamped frames by interpolation/ramp; no randomness.

overheating.alert: Engine temperature exceeds configured demo threshold.
overheating.recommended_action: Stop operation when safe to do so and inspect the cooling system before continued operation.

location_mismatch.condition: asset remains outside assigned-site radius for >= 20 minutes
location_mismatch.alert: Asset is operating outside its assigned site.
location_mismatch.recommended_action: Verify asset movement with the dealer/customer and update allocation records if relocation is legitimate.

seatbelt_safety_violation.alert: Operator seatbelt violation detected during machine operation.
seatbelt_safety_violation.recommended_action: Stop safely, correct seatbelt use, coach the operator and acknowledge the safety event.

abnormal_fuel.alert: Fuel consumption is above the configured demo threshold.
abnormal_fuel.recommended_action: Review load/operating conditions and inspect if the abnormal pattern persists.

abnormal_idle.condition: idle_minutes >= 300 in a day-equivalent demo window
abnormal_idle.recommended_action: Verify operating status and review whether the asset should remain deployed.
